note: 词组升级：给一句平淡的原句 + 三个必须用上的词组，你把它们串成一句更像考官写的话。note 只讲搭配和介词，why 讲句子怎么组织。

sets.d: 垃圾、污染、禁令这类题的主体段和结论段

items.scene: 第二段：说不禁令的副作用，先讲塑料袋的危害
items.base: Plastic bags are very bad for the environment.

need.note: harm 前可加 considerable / serious；介词固定用 to，不能写 harm for。
end up in + 地点，in 不能换成 on；它强调「结局」，不是「过程」。
take + 时间 + to do 是固定结构；break down 才表示「降解」，decompose 多用于有机物。

items.en: Single-use plastic bags do considerable harm to the environment and end up in landfill, where they take centuries to break down.
items.why: 先用 and 把「伤害」和「去向」并列，再接 where 从句补「多久」。三个词组各占一个位置：谓语 → 并列谓语 → 从句谓语，句子就不会散。

items.scene: 第三段：承认污染确实严重（让步段开头）
items.base: Plastic waste is a big problem in the ocean.

need.note: threat 前用 serious / major；to 是介词，后面接被威胁的对象。
life 在这里不可数，不加 s；修饰语用 marine，不用 sea。
被动语态；ingest 是「吞下」，比 eat 书面，动物误食塑料常用这个词。

items.en: Plastic waste in the ocean poses a serious threat to marine life, as small fragments are easily ingested by fish and birds.
items.why: 主句先给判断（pose a threat），as 从句再给机制（被吞食）。中文习惯「因为…所以…」，英文写作更常见的是结论在前、原因在后。

items.scene: 第二段：说禁令为什么执行不了
items.base: It is hard for the government to stop shops from using bags.

need.note: 固定说法，sale 用单数；写作里用它代替 in the shop。
monitor 直接接宾语，不加 on；impossible to do 用不定式。
particularly 修饰介词短语，比 very much in 自然；书面语里比 especially 略正式。

items.en: Enforcing such a rule is almost impossible to monitor at the point of sale, particularly in small shops and street markets.
items.why: 主语用动名词短语 Enforcing such a rule，谓语用 is——一句话里不要再用 it is hard to 这种形式主语，两个 it 会打架。

items.scene: 结论段：给替代方案，收全文
items.base: Charging for bags works better than banning them.

need.note: charge 可数，要加 a；modest 表示「不高」，比 small 正式。
curb 直接接宾语，不加 of；consumption 不可数，不加 s。
固定短语 at source 不加 the，指「在产生的地方就处理」。

items.en: A modest charge on bags is more likely to curb consumption at source than an outright ban is.
items.why: 比较结构 more likely to do ... than ... 两边要同类：左边是不定式，右边用 than an outright ban is 补齐谓语，比较才站得住。

sets.d: 上大学、选专业、学习方式这类题

items.scene: 第二段：说上大学的好处
items.base: Going to university helps you get a better job.

need.note: to 是介词，后面接名词，不是动词原形。
opportunity 可数，泛指要复数。
range of 后面接复数名词；wider 是比较级，和 than 呼应。

items.en: Graduates have access to a wider range of job opportunities than those who leave school early.
items.why: 比较对象必须同类：graduates 对 those who leave school early，不能写成 than leaving school early，那是拿人比动作。

items.scene: 第三段：说学历是硬门槛
items.base: You cannot be a doctor without a degree.

need.note: it 是形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式；后面再接 become 原形。
without 后面接动名词，不接动词原形。
relevant 前加 the，表示「该专业对应的那个」。

items.en: It is impossible to become a doctor, teacher or lawyer without having the relevant degree.
items.why: it is + 形容词 + to do 是英语里最常用的「评价句」骨架，比 You cannot 客观得多，作文里优先用这个。

items.scene: 第四段：说就业竞争，给背景
items.base: The job market is very competitive now.

need.note: 修饰形容词，比 more and more 书面，也不用加 very。
形容市场、行业、人；名词是 competition，competitor 是「竞争者」。
applicants 复数；applicant 是「申请人」，apply 是动词。

items.en: The job market is becoming increasingly competitive, with hundreds of applicants for a single position.
items.why: with + 名词 是补背景的常用尾巴，把「竞争激烈」具体成一个可数的画面，比另起一句 there are many people 省字。

items.scene: 第二段：说学生应该能自由选专业
items.base: Students should study what they like.

need.note: free to do 用不定式；be free to 不是 be free of。
areas 复数；area of study 是「学科领域」的固定说法。
about 是介词，后面接名词或 what 从句，不接动词原形。

items.en: Students should be free to choose their preferred areas of study, because people learn better when they are passionate about the subject.
items.why: because 从句里再套 when 从句，是两个层级的从属：主句 → 原因 → 条件。写完要检查每个从句是不是都有主语和谓语。

sets.d: 手机、网络、游戏、社交媒体这类题

items.scene: 第二段：说科技改变了交流方式
items.base: Technology has changed how people talk to each other.

need.note: impact 前用 an；介词 on，不能写 impact to。

alts: the way in which people communicate
need.note: the way 后面不加 how，这是最常见的多余词。
ways 复数；various 前不加 very。

items.en: Technology has had an impact on the way people communicate in various ways, both at work and in social life.
items.why: have had 用现在完成，表示影响从过去延续到现在；the way people communicate 是省略 that 的同位语结构，比 how people communicate 更正式。

items.scene: 第三段：说负面影响
items.base: Phones make people less social.

need.note: 及物动词，直接接人，不加 from 也可以，但常写 isolate sb from sth。
discourage sb from doing sth；反义词 encourage。
interaction 不可数；修饰语用 real，不用 true。

items.en: Constant use of phones can isolate people and discourage real interaction with those around them.
items.why: 两个动词用 and 并列，共用一个主语 constant use of phones——比写成两句话紧凑，也是高分作文常见的并列谓语写法。

items.scene: 第四段：说游戏为什么让人停不下来
items.base: Many children play games for too long.

need.note: 形容事物；人上瘾要用 be addicted to，两个词不能混。
修饰动词，位置在 be 动词后、实义动词前。
sacrifice sth for sth，for 后面是被换来的东西，不是被牺牲的。

items.en: Games are highly addictive because users are constantly given new targets, and many children sacrifice homework for a few more hours of play.
items.why: because 从句里用被动 are given，把「谁给的」隐去，重点落在「不断有新目标」这件事上——该省的主语就省掉。

items.scene: 结论段：权衡利弊，给立场
items.base: The problems are bigger than the good points.

need.note: 及物动词，本身含比较义，后面不能再加 than。
dangers 复数；potential 前不加 very。
修饰抽象名词，比 big 正式；副词是 significantly。

items.en: In my view, the potential dangers of gaming outweigh its benefits, and the difference is significant.
items.why: outweigh 后面直接接宾语，不要再加 than；如果要写 than，就得换成 are greater than。这一句是「优缺点类」最省力的结论句。

sets.d: 该不该出钱、钱花在哪、城市治理这类题

items.scene: 第二段：说政府应该支持艺术
items.base: Governments should give money to art.

need.note: for 是介词；support 在这里不可数，不加 a。
指门类整体时用 the arts，指「艺术」这个概念时用不可数的 art。
spaces 复数指多处；space 不可数时是「空间」这个概念。

items.en: Governments should provide financial support for the arts, especially for works displayed in public spaces.
items.why: 两处都用 for，第二处用 especially for 补范围，比另起一句 In addition 更省字，也让句子有层次。

items.scene: 第三段：说钱更该花在哪
items.base: The money should be spent on things people need.

need.note: spend money on sth 的被动；on 不能换成 in。
services 复数；healthcare、transport 都算 basic services。
两边要接同类成分；前后都是名词短语或都是动名词。

items.en: Public money should be spent on basic services such as healthcare and transport rather than on statues.
items.why: rather than 两边要平行：on basic services 对 on statues，第二个 on 不能省，否则读者会以为 statues 是服务的一种。

items.scene: 第四段：说保护环境不是浪费钱
items.base: Protecting animals is not a waste of money.

need.note: far 修饰比较级或 outweigh，不用 very；very outweigh 是错的。
conservation 不可数；cost 可数，指具体开支时常用复数。
for the benefit of sb，benefit 前用 the。

items.en: The cost of managing environmental change would far outweigh the cost of conservation, which is why protecting habitats is for the benefit of humans too.
items.why: which is why 把「结果」接成从句，比另起一句 Therefore 更连贯；Therefore 一篇里用两次就显得生硬。

items.scene: 第二段：说城市生活的问题
items.base: Living in a city is expensive and stressful.

need.note: 固定搭配，living 不加 ly，也不说 living cost。
后接动词原形；比 usually 更适合客观陈述。
一个词就够，不要写 very crowded；crowded 只是「挤」，overcrowded 是「挤到成问题」。

items.en: The cost of living in large cities is high, and public transport tends to be overcrowded, which makes city life stressful.
items.why: 主语换成事物（cost / transport）时，谓语用单数 is / tends——中国学生最容易在这里误用 are。

sets.d: 选工作、薪水、职业满意度这类题

items.scene: 第二段：说薪水确实重要（让步）
items.base: Money is important when you choose a job.

need.note: needs 复数；meet 在这里是「满足」，不是「遇见」。
quality of life 前用 a；of 不能换成 for。
cover the cost / the bills；这个用法比 pay for 更书面。

items.en: Most people need a salary that allows them to meet their basic needs and have a reasonable quality of life.
items.why: that allows them to 后面接两个动词原形 meet / have，共用一个 to——不要写成 to meet and to have，重复 to 反而累赘。

items.scene: 第三段：说同事和氛围同样重要
items.base: The people you work with are also important.

need.note: as ... as 中间用形容词原级，不能写 as more important as。
atmosphere 前用 the；介词用 in。
to 是介词，后面接名词或 how 从句。

items.en: Friendly colleagues are just as important as the salary, because the atmosphere in a workplace can make a huge difference to how people feel.
items.why: just as ... as 用来「拉平」两个因素，是讨论类作文里表「同样重要」最省事的句式，比 also very important 清楚得多。

items.scene: 第四段：说成就感来自哪里
items.base: People also want to feel good about their work.

need.note: 不可数，不加 a，也不加 s。
from 是介词；主语是单数时用 comes。
achievements 复数；professional 修饰人时是「专业的」，修饰事时是「职业上的」。

items.en: For many people, job satisfaction comes from professional achievements and the skills they learn rather than from the money they earn.
items.why: come from A rather than from B，第二个 from 要保留，比较才清楚；they learn / they earn 是省略 that 的定语从句。

items.scene: 结论段：给最终判断
items.base: Money is not the only thing.

need.note: 及物动词，直接接宾语，不加 than。
复数是 motivators；动词是 motivate，形容词是 motivated。
放句首引导让步从句，主句要给相反判断；while 后面不加 but。

items.en: While salaries certainly affect people's choice of profession, money does not outweigh all other motivators.
items.why: while 放句首表让步，主句必须转折；这是让步段最常见的开头。注意 while 从句里不能再用 but，中文的「虽然…但是」在英文里只能留一个。

sets.d: 广告、消费、企业责任这类题

items.scene: 第二段：说广告的正向作用
items.base: Ads tell people what they can buy.

need.note: inform sb about / of sth，不能写 inform us the choices（漏掉介词）。
available 后置修饰名词；放名词前意思会变。
part 前用 a；part of 后面接整体。

items.en: Advertisements inform us about the choices available and remain a key part of modern business.
items.why: choices available 是「名词 + 后置形容词」，等于 the choices that are available，省掉从句更利落。两个谓语 inform / remain 共用一个主语。

items.scene: 第三段：说广告在操控人
items.base: Ads make people want things they do not need.

need.note: persuade sb that + 完整从句；persuade sb to do 是「说服某人做」。
泛指时不加 s；具体某个品牌用 a brand image。
加 a 表示「一种」；consumer 作定语用单数。

items.en: Advertisers try to persuade us that buying a product will make us happier, and in this way they strengthen a consumer culture.
items.why: persuade sb that 后面是完整句子；in this way 回指前半句的手段，是把两句连起来最轻的连接词。

items.scene: 第四段：说企业该承担社会责任
items.base: Companies should do more than make money.

need.note: 泛指多项时用复数；作不可数概念时用单数。
well 是副词，不能写 good；employees 复数。
rather than 后面接动名词，和前面的动词保持平行。

items.en: Companies have social responsibilities: they should treat their employees well rather than exploiting them to cut costs.
items.why: 冒号后面解释冒号前面的名词，是写作里最省力的展开方式；rather than 后面接动名词，和前面的 treat 呼应。

items.scene: 结论段：收全文
items.base: Companies should care about society, not only profit.

need.note: on 是介词；place 在这里不是「地方」。
中间用不可数名词或原级形容词，不能用 more。
objectives 复数；比 money goals 正式。

items.en: Companies should place as much importance on their social responsibilities as they do on their financial objectives.
items.why: as much importance on A as they do on B：第二个 on 不能省，do 代替 place 避免重复动词。这是「两者并重」最工整的一句。
